_comment: One-shot DATA migrations: migrations whose purpose was to rewrite specific
business rows that existed on production at a specific moment. They are
schema-neutral — replaying them rebuilds no structure and no behavior.
They must never be replayed onto a database whose ledger does not already
contain them. Their authorization was bound to the live population at the
time they were written; a restored, staging, or drifted database is a
different population, and running the same UPDATE there rewrites rows
nobody approved. After a real restore the corrected values come back with
the DATA restore, not by re-running the edit.
from the replay plan and says so on stderr. --include-one-shot overrides it,
which is a deliberate, reviewed act, never a default.
Add an entry the moment a one-shot data migration is written. Schema and
function migrations do NOT belong here — they are idempotent by contract
and the replay plan must keep rebuilding them.

one_shot.20260810025159_backfill_stale_line_profi: Recomputed line-level profit for a 37-row population approved on 2026-08-09. Authorized by row/order/price counts, not by row identity — a different population with the same counts would satisfy that guard. Applied live; per AGENTS.md an applied migration is never edited, so containment lives here.
one_shot.20261007150100_mark_spring_2026_deliveri: Records 53 named spring 2026 deliveries on 33 orders as billed outside CRX (in Chem Man), owner-approved 2026-10-07. Bound to those live delivery and order numbers; on any other population its preflight refuses.
one_shot.20261007150200_release_reservations_of_d: Releases the reservations of four orders soft-deleted while still confirmed (4,607.1 units, 27 products) and of one deleted test order (36 units), owner-approved 2026-10-07. Bound to the live per-product reservation totals; its preflight refuses unless every product reconciles exactly.
one_shot.20261105170000_data11_preferred_vendor_l: Gives each active product its preferred vendor link from Mason's 2026-11-03 approved list (DATA-11). Bound to named live product and vendor ids, each product's current vendor text and a named approving admin; on any other population its preflight refuses. 20261105180000 checks only products that have links, so the restore data proof in supabase/baselines/README.md checks that every active product has exactly one active, confirmed preferred link to a live vendor matching its vendor text.
one_shot.20261214100000_ki30_epa_registration_cor: Sets the EPA registration number on 48 named products to EPA's registry value (KI-30), owner-approved and applied live 2026-11-08. Bound to the live product ids, names and stored numbers at that moment; on any other population (a fresh build, or a restore that already holds the corrected numbers) its preflight refuses with KI30_ROW_MOVED. After a restore the corrected numbers come back with the data.
one_shot.20270101010000_unit_spellings_remap: Moves 20 named products onto one unit spelling (RT-2 step 1: Oz to oz, Qt to qt with their inventory snapshots, LB to Lb on Imazuron Herbicide and its product family). Mason chose the spellings on 2026-11-09; the 2026-11-10 family redesign needs his fresh live-apply approval, and no earlier approval covers it. Bound to the live product ids, names, forms, current spellings, product families, the 14 unit_conversions rows and the old-spelling inventory snapshot count at that moment; on any other population its preflight refuses (RT2A_ROW_MOVED, RT2A_UNITS_DRIFT, RT2A_INVENTORY_DRIFT, RT2A_FAMILY_OR_WEIGHT). After a restore the remapped spellings come back with the data.
one_shot.20270121100000_ki137_powder_keg_each_pik: Moves Powder Keg Corn and Soybeans from Lb to Ea (product, family, stock rows, open order lines; a new cost basis at the same cents) and relabels Piksi Dust Plus's stock row and open PO, order and delivery lines from Dry oz to MG (KI-137, Mason 2026-11-13). Bound to the live product, family, cost-basis, stock-row and line ids, units and quantities at that moment; on any other population its preflight refuses (KI137_ROW_MOVED, KI137_UNLISTED_OPEN_LINE). After a restore the new labels come back with the data; relabels Treaty Extra's received PO-2026-0011 line and its stock row from "oz" to "Dry oz" (same size).
one_shot.20270227150000_live_test_data_reset: One-time reset of Mason's live test data before the Dec 15 trial (Mason, 2026-11-23): stock to 0, the field side, purchasing and all money cleared, every customer at $0 prepay, document numbering restarted at 0001, every deleted row copied first into schema reset_backup_20261123. Runs only where pg_control_system().system_identifier and the pinned admin, customer and product ids match the live pins written into it; anywhere else (staging, a fresh build, a restore) it is a no-op notice (LIVE_RESET_SKIPPED_NOT_LIVE), and on live it refuses unless every public table's row count equals its pin (LIVE_RESET_COUNT_DRIFT) and the backup schema does not exist yet (LIVE_RESET_ALREADY_APPLIED). After a restore the emptied tables come back with the data, never by re-running this.
